previously_rejected: The plate-17 side is not a corridor. a_native 2518.0 is the midpoint of lattice.json units.17.y.faces[1] = [2351, 2685], whose two faces lie on different ground: y=2350.5 exists only for x < ~700 and is the north face of 52ND ST inside plate 17's DETACHED 'Union Slaughtering Co. - Located 3 Miles W of P.O.' inset (printed 52ND ST, 80', address run 1002-1016), while y=2685 is the 8TH ST south face of the downtown map (x >= 1300). Plate 17 is a composite sheet split near native x~1280. The implied 334 px roadway is no Galveston roadway on this scan (80' street = 242 px, 70' avenue = 212 px, 20' alley = 61 px) and plate 17's other two street chains are 244 and 245 px. Both reviewers independently reached the same finding, named the same replacement corridor (8TH ST) and read the same face pair to within 1.5 px - plate 17 north 2437.2-2438.9 / south 2679.7-2681.0 (runs 214-224 even, 213-223 odd, blocks 607/608), plate 18 north 2446.8-2447.7 / south 2687.5-2688.4 (runs 302-312 even, 301-311 odd, blocks 547/548), the 200|300 break falling on Ave C (Mechanic) exactly as the accepted pair_17_18 x-tie argues. The control is therefore removed from the solve rather than trusted.
re_read: wave 4 (outputs/1912/qc/wave4/proposal_17_18.md) settles the value the two P2-3 reviewers could not agree on, by taking the FACE rather than the centre. At their evaluation points the plates draw different roadway widths (17: 70'; 18: 80'), and plate 17's own 70'/80' half-width difference is 17.05 px = 5.6 ft - exactly the reviewers' disagreement (2581.1 vs 2564.0). The SOUTH face is continuous on both plates (17: 2685.36 -> 2679.87 with no break at Strand, the widening being taken off the north side; 18: 2685.60 -> 2688.00), so it is a reading and not a choice: a_native 2685.4 (17), b_native 2685.6 (18). Independent width-free check: the plate-internal distance from the 8th St south face to the seawall centreline along the Ave C meridian is 576.8 ft on 17 and 575.4 ft on 18, 0.24% apart, so the step is placement plus sheet scale, not a drawing difference. Identity unchanged from the rejection note: both print 8TH ST., 17 carries 101-123/110-124 then 201-223/202-224 and 18 carries 301-323 east of Mechanic, the 200|300 break on Ave C as the accepted x-tie argues; one street off would move ~1,200 px. Previous (rejected) values 2518.0 / 2566.0 are kept above as a_native_previous / b_native_previous.
prior_reviewers_note: No replacement a_native/b_native is written here and no re-solve was run. The two reviewers disagree on the value by 5.6 ft at the point localsolve evaluates: reviewer 1 measures plate 17's 8th St centre as 2581.1 at the plate's extent-centre x (2558.5 in the shared band beside plate 18) and declines to choose, because plate 17 draws 8th St 70 ft wide west of Strand (faces 2477/2685.1, '70'' printed) and 80 ft east of it (2439/2681.4, '80'' printed), so its north line jogs 12.5 ft at Strand and any single a_native is a choice, not a reading; reviewer 2 fits the continuous SOUTH face across the sheet and derives 2564.0 / 2563.7. Under the Gate A standard a contested value may not be written, and a --similarity re-solve of three plates on it (which would change their scale and rotation) is out of scope. Both reviewers agree the correction does NOT close the seawall steps at edge_00/edge_01 in any case (best case leaves 6-10 ft at 17|18 and 7-9 ft at 18|19, over blank beach paper 2200-3400 native px north of the nearest shared corridor). Candidate values recorded for a future task: reviewer 1 near-seam 2558.5 / 2567.8, reviewer 1 plate-centre 2581.1 / 2564.5, reviewer 2 south-face fit 2564.0 / 2563.7.
